method: Run the offline archive-consistency verifier. It checks the tracked archive-summary fixture against the lesson claims, optional local archive source hashes, downstream references and compilation of the complete Python fence. The historical provider harness is inspected statically and never executed.

observations.trace: Tiny 4 / decoy 2 / noop 1 historical run counts are bounded to retained labels; weak scorer, missing responses and missing click coordinates are disclosed; unsupported rates and cross-chapter multipliers were removed.

limitations: No original per-turn provider requests/responses, model routing trace, click coordinates, or final stored field values are present.
The archived pass/fail labels are outputs of a weak scorer, not verified task-success observations; this review does not estimate a success rate.
The fixture records inspected historical summaries and source hashes. It does not make the ignored historical provider artifacts available in a clean checkout.
No live provider call, real browser/desktop action, production authorization, or external business side effect was tested.
